description: Anonymised FQResi .Resi files and IML Resistograph traces for imlresi tests. Built by tools/build_corpus.py.
anonymisation: file names, df$FileName and per-trace list names are C<nn>_<mm>.<ext> or T<nnn>.<ext>
TreeID/idNumber replaced by neutral ids with the original separators
comments/remarks, names, non-coordinate locations, memoryId, assessment texts and annotators replaced by placeholders
instrument serials (ResiCode/snrMachine/toolserial) mapped to PD400-9xxx/PD500-9xxx, snrElectronic to 9xxxx groups, consistently across .Resi files and traces
coordinates shifted by one random offset per case (off-shore); string formats kept
dates, settings, species, direction and all measured values unchanged
